source: JPL Horizons, satellite ephemeris sat441 (state vectors, Saturn-centred, ICRF)
method: Piecewise (one segment per year; Mimas 15 days, Hyperion 30 days, Iapetus 2 years): mean longitude with periodic terms in λ and 2λ whose amplitudes vary slowly in time, plus radius and out-of-plane offset, fitted by least squares to geometric Saturn-centred positions. Valid within the fitted span only.
